sloka: सुरैः सहेन्द्रैरपि सम्गरे कथम् ।ममाग्रतः स्थास्यति लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ॥६-१०-२८॥।।
transliteration: suraiḥ sahendrairapi samgare katham ।mamāgrataḥ sthāsyati lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ॥6-10-28॥।।

translations.english: "I do not perceive fear from anyone. Rama will not be able to get Mythili at any time. How can the elder brother of Lakshmana withstand me even if Indra and Devatas come (to his help) in battle"
